Our story

settings.title: Built on Doing the Right Thing

settings.editor: Giving our neighbors a heating and cooling company they can genuinely trust was the simple initial goal of Mid Lakes Heating & Cooling. Honest, trustworthy, and truly local—not the biggest or most ostentatious.

One repair and one cozy house at a time, we have expanded since 2018 by doing the right thing for our clients. Our technicians have over 75 years of combined experience, but what really makes us stand out is the way we treat people: honest responses, excellent work, and no pressure.
Ownership

Born in Georgia, John Jessup was raised in Loganville, where he currently resides with his spouse. John joined the US Army after graduating from high school and spent three years serving his country. In 1993, he graduated from the University of Georgia with a degree in accountancy.

John is in charge of Mid Lakes Heating & Cooling’s accounting, banking, insurance, and administrative departments—the back-end work that keeps everything honest and efficient for each and every client.

As a member of the Walton County Board of Education, John is also quite active in the community where he was raised. He enjoys fishing, hunting, watching college football, and yes, supporting the Dawgs, when he’s not working or giving back to the community.
Our values
We’ll make the necessary repairs and clearly advise you when a replacement is the better course of action. There is no compulsion to upsell unnecessary items.

settings.title: We Treat Your Home Like Ours

settings.editor: Because we would want the same in our own homes, our professionals respect your space, arrive prepared, and work carefully.

settings.title: We Look at the Whole Home

settings.editor: Sometimes the equipment isn’t the issue. In order to address the true problem, we examine beyond the furnace and air conditioner to insulation, humidity, and what’s going on beneath your house.

background_image.alt: Modern rooftop ventilation vents on a concrete facade

settings.editor: Beyond HVAC

settings.title: The Work Most Companies Stop Short Of

settings.editor: The equipment is where most heating and cooling companies end up. We don’t. Mid Lakes assists with crawl space encapsulation, attic insulation, and humidity control in addition to HVAC repair, maintenance and installation—the whole-house upgrades that reduce system effort and improve the consistency of your rooms. It’s what makes us different.
